reports.notes: Only 1.PNG shows this report; state = 'Confirmation Call List' selected (the other five list types were not captured, so their enabled/disabled combinations are unknown). THE CLIPPING IS AT THE TOP, NOT THE BOTTOM: the criteria area was captured scrolled to its bottom end. Directly under the panel border there is only a 10 px strip of a full-width header bar (normal bars are 24-25 px) and the 1 px light line that tops the criteria content in every other screenshot is missing, i.e. the content sits about 16 px higher than normal while its last line ends exactly at the action bar. Consequences: (a) the title of the first section (the list-type radios) cannot be read - recorded as [?]; (b) it cannot be ruled out that more content lies above it. NO 'PRINT FORMAT' (PDF / Excel) section is visible for this report although the other 8 reports of the category have one - the pixels do not tell whether it does not exist here or is scrolled out of view above; verify on the live screen. The bottom edge is complete: SORT BY is the last section, followed by the closing 1 px line and the action bar. Layout top to bottom: [clipped full-width header] + list-type radios (full width); OFFICE/GROUP | PROVIDER; DATE RANGE (full width); EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE | EXCLUDE RESP. PARTY TYPE; CANCELLATION REASON | OPERATORY; APPOINTMENT TYPE (full-width header: Length on the left half, Status checkboxes on the right half); OTHER OPTIONS (full-width header: one checkbox in each half); SORT BY (full width). GREYED OUT in this state: SELECT buttons of EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE, EXCLUDE RESP. PARTY TYPE, CANCELLATION REASON and OPERATORY; Length dropdown; Status checkboxes Missed and Cancelled; Include Off Call List; all four SORT BY radios. ENABLED: list-type radios, Office / Office Group + office SELECT, Provider SELECT, Start Date / End Date, Include Patient Balance (checked). Presumably the other list types enable other subsets (e.g. Cancellation Reason for Cancelled List) - inference only, not shown.

observations: Third-reader verified inventory: all 9 original screenshots and all pre-rendered zooms were re-read, every A-vs-B difference was settled on the pixels, and each file was swept for missed elements with a colour scan of the criteria area (nothing beyond the controls listed here was found). COVERAGE: all 9 files are the same two-panel screen in its normal state - no popup, no expanded dropdown, no second view of the same report; each screenshot shows a different report selected (blue radio dot located in each file), so all 9 listed reports are covered exactly once: 1=Appointment List, 2=Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed, 3=New Patients via Appointments, 4=Lab Report, 5=SmartAssist Report Card, 6=Appointments Confirmed Via Vendors, 7=Appointment Time Stamps, 8=Appointment Detail, 9=Lab Cost Report. TITLE BAR (identical in all 9): 'Appointment Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a printer icon at the right. No footer text (only a thin grey window-edge strip below the panels). LEFT PANEL 'SELECT REPORT': 9 radio entries in a two-column grid (5 in the left column, 4 in the right, bottom-right cell empty); 'Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed' wraps onto two lines; large empty area below - the list is not scrollable or clipped. Casing as displayed: 'New Patients via Appointments' (lower-case via) but 'Appointments Confirmed Via Vendors' (capital Via). A splitter handle (three dots) sits between the two panels. RIGHT PANEL 'REPORT CRITERIA': grey CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) at the right end of the blue panel bar - same grey look in all 9 files, so it is its normal style, not a disabled state; blue PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and '+ ADD TO MY FAVORITES' buttons sit in a grey action bar pinned to the bottom of the panel. No static instruction / legend text anywhere in the criteria panels. NOT VISIBLE ANYWHERE in this category: the contents of the Office / Office Group / Provider / User / Operatory / Lab / Vendors / Cancellation Reason / Patient Type / Resp. Party Type pickers and the other values of the 'Length' dropdown (only 'Any' is shown); only one state per report was captured, so controls that depend on a radio or checkbox choice (the other five list types of Appointment List, the other Lab Report types, Only AppointNow Appointments ticked, GROUP BY = User, Include Cancelled Appointments ticked) are seen only in their default-state enabled/disabled form. RECURRING DEFAULTS: PRINT FORMAT = PDF (options PDF, Excel) on 8 of 9 reports - none visible on Appointment List; OFFICE/GROUP = Office (options Office, Office Group) with an unlabelled read-only box showing 108 (= OID) + SELECT on all 9; a Provider picker (ALL) on 7 reports (absent on New Patients via Appointments and Appointments Confirmed Via Vendors); User / Lab / Vendors / Operatory / Cancellation Reason pickers = ALL; EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE + EXCLUDE RESP. PARTY TYPE pickers = None on Appointment List (greyed), Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed, Lab Report and Lab Cost Report; every date box = 11/21/2026 (the capture date, i.e. today) with a calendar icon. SELECT button icons: building (Office, Lab, Vendors, Cancellation Reason), single person (Provider, Operatory), person-plus (User, Exclude Patient Type, Exclude Resp. Party Type). DISABLED-STATE EVIDENCE (pixel colours, not just by eye): disabled SELECT buttons are grey (176,183,190) instead of blue (41,134,220); disabled radio / checkbox labels are grey (161,161,161) instead of black; disabled inputs and dropdowns use the fill 220,223,226 of the read-only picker boxes instead of the 241,241,241 of enabled inputs (calibrated against the other report categories: about 35 dropdowns there use the light fill, the only other grey one is a dependency-gated Fee Schedule dropdown in My Reports). Greyed controls exist only in 1.PNG (Appointment List: both Exclude SELECT buttons, Cancellation Reason SELECT, Operatory SELECT, Length dropdown, Status Missed / Cancelled, Include Off Call List, all four SORT BY radios), 4.PNG (Lab Report: Due Date box) and 8.PNG (Appointment Detail: Both / Appoint Now / Appoint Now API radios, the 'User' option of PAGE BREAK BY, Cancellation Reason SELECT). TWO REPORTS DO NOT FIT THE VIEWPORT: the criteria viewport has a fixed height (482 px between the panel border and the action bar in every file) and no scrollbar is drawn even when the content is taller. (a) Appointment List (1.PNG) was captured scrolled to its bottom end - it is the only screenshot (also compared with the criteria screens of the other report categories) whose content does not start with a 1 px light line followed by a full 25 px header: its first header bar is cut to a 10 px strip without text, so that title is unreadable (it cannot even be told whether the bar carries a title), and no PRINT FORMAT section is visible; unknown whether the report has none or it is hidden above. (b) Appointment Detail (8.PNG) is clipped at the BOTTOM: a third row under OTHER OPTIONS begins exactly at the edge (1 px sliver). Both need verification on the live system; the other seven reports end with empty panel space below their last section and are complete. FONT CAVEAT: in the bold caps section-header font the G is drawn almost like a C at this size, so the headers look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'DATE RANCE', 'APPOINTMENT DATE RANCE', 'CROUP BY', 'PACE BREAK BY'; a pixel comparison with real C glyphs (e.g. in CANCELLATION) shows the extra lower-right stroke of a G, so they are transcribed as OFFICE/GROUP, DATE RANGE, APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE, GROUP BY, PAGE BREAK BY. NAMING DIFFERENCES worth keeping: the date section is 'DATE RANGE' on six reports but 'APPOINTMENT DATE RANGE' on Lab Report, SmartAssist Report Card and Lab Cost Report; 'PROVIDER' vs 'PROVIDER/USER' (Appointment Detail only); the first-row selector is titled 'REPORT TYPE' (Lab Report, Lab Cost Report), 'REPORT FORMAT' (SmartAssist Report Card) or 'APPOINTMENT TYPE' (Appointment Detail: Regular / Archived), while on Appointment List 'APPOINTMENT TYPE' is a different section (Length dropdown + Status checkboxes); header 'APPOINT NOW' is two words whereas its checkbox says 'AppointNow'; the balance option is worded 'Include Patient Balance' on Appointment List but 'Show Patient Balance' on Missed Appointments Not Marked As Missed (both ticked by default). Not part of this category's 9 files: the parent folder also holds drop_down_options.PNG (the Reports menu), not transcribed here.
